name: IDPH Free Standing Emergency Center Directory

columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the licensed Freestanding Emergency Center

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street address of the facility's physical location. Suite or building numbers are included where applicable.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality in which the facility is physically located.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county in which the facility is physically located. Used for Health Service Area (HSA) and regional planning analyses.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the facility's physical location.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Primary administrative or compliance contact at the facility, designated for HFSRB correspondence. Not necessarily the medical director or facility administrator.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Main published telephone number for the facility, including area code. Format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

columns.name: License Number
columns.description: License number issued by HFSRB authorizing the facility to operate as a Freestanding Emergency Center under the Illinois Health Facilities Planning Act.

columns.name: Exp. Date
columns.description: Date on which the facility's current license expires. Facilities must submit a renewal application prior to this date to maintain authority to operate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
